name: repetitive_sums_benchmark
description: A small benchmark that tests models' ability to compute repeated/additive arithmetic (repetitive sums) presented as text prompts. It measures numeric calculation correctness and robustness to repetition and formatting variations, highlighting models' arithmetic and iterative reasoning capabilities. Designed to probe failure modes in simple arithmetic across prompt variations.
reputation: A niche, community-contributed dataset for arithmetic probing; modest adoption in targeted evaluation studies.
